unlisted_practices: Conduct ablation analyses comparing adult-only, pediatric-only, and domain-adapted model variants to quantify whether adult training data bias pediatric predictions.
Report patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals or mixed-effects sensitivity analyses to account for within-patient clustering of slice-level performance estimates.

Evaluate generative tumor growth prediction against radiotherapy-relevant benchmarks, including radiation oncologist-delineated target volumes, conventional isotropic expansion margins, geographic miss, and normal-tissue exposure.
Include blinded qualitative review by radiation oncologists of whether predicted growth maps would alter target-volume delineation or adaptive planning decisions.
Report growth-region-specific performance separately from full-tumor performance.
Validate generative tumor growth models in larger, more representative external cohorts before clinical translation.
